episodes.title: Spring of the DEAD
episodes.summary: A deadly virus is turning the world's population unto walking corpses and Takashi Komuro and his friends frantically search for a way to break free from the living dead.

episodes.title: Escape from the DEAD
episodes.summary: As the entire school spirals into chaos, more players jump into the fight, handmade weapons locked and loaded. New enemy traits are discovered, and the survivors realize the situation they are really in.

episodes.title: Democracy Under the DEAD
episodes.summary: The enemy's weak points are discovered and exploited. Everyone's base survival instincts kick in. Tensions rise as more people swell the ranks, and one survivor refuses to continue with the group.

episodes.title: Running in the DEAD
episodes.summary: In times of crisis, even the most mundane activities become a monumental task. While on their way to the rendezvous, Rei and Komuro find that there is more to fear in this new world besides the walking dead.

episodes.title: Streets of the DEAD
episodes.summary: Chaos runs wild in the streets. Crossing any bridge presents a world of problems for Komuro and Rei, while dissension among the ranks split the bus group in two.

episodes.title: In the DEAD of the Night
episodes.summary: Time for some R and R! While the group relaxes and gathers supplies at the safe house, things heat up in the streets, and dramatic measures must be taken to keep the peace.

episodes.title: DEAD Night and the DEAD Ruck
episodes.summary: Fully rested and armed to the teeth, the group looks on as people are eaten alive in the streets below and learn a valuable lesson: you can't save them all.

episodes.title: The DEAD Way Home
episodes.summary: The group takes a wrong turn and becomes trapped. With no help in sight and a wall of the living dead surrounding them, how many waves will be able to be fought off?

episodes.title: The Sword and DEAD
episodes.summary: After narrowly escaping with their lives, Komuro and Saeko must make their way alone and rendezvous with the others, Saeko's true nature is revealed, and it begs the question: Is her beauty only skin deep?

episodes.title: The DEAD's House Rules
episodes.summary: The group reunites at Takagi's house, an impenetrable fortress run by her parents and their army of workers, but being absorbed into a larger group becomes a huge concern.

episodes.title: DEAD Storm Rising
episodes.summary: Tempers flare in the house of Saya Tagagi. A Leader must be chosen, and a man from the group's past makes an unexpected return.

episodes.title: All DEAD'S Attack
episodes.summary: After an EMP wave shuts down all electronic equipment in a wide radius, Komuro and his friends must defend the mansion or risk losing all that matters to them.
